ASEAN to Discuss Transboundary Haze Ahead of Summit

The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) is set to discuss tackling transboundary haze pollution in the lead-up to its November summit. Malaysia has indicated that this issue will be on the agenda.
